entries.title: Acts 26:1
segments: ¶Then Agrippa said to Paul, "You are permitted to speak for yourself." So Paul stretched out his hand and answered for himself:

entries.title: Acts 26:2
segments: "I think myself happy, King Agrippa, because today I shall answer for myself before you concerning all the things of which I am accused by the Jews,

entries.title: Acts 26:3
segments: "especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which have to do with the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

entries.title: Acts 26:4
segments: "My manner of life from my youth, which was spent from the beginning among my own nation at Jerusalem, all the Jews know.

entries.title: Acts 26:5
segments: "They knew me from the first, if they were willing to testify, that according to the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

entries.title: Acts 26:6
segments: "And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers.

entries.title: Acts 26:7
segments: "To this [promise] our twelve tribes, earnestly serving [God] night and day, hope to attain. For this hope's sake, King Agrippa, I am accused by the Jews.

entries.title: Acts 26:8
segments: "Why should it be thought incredible by you that God raises the dead?

entries.title: Acts 26:9
segments: "Indeed, I myself thought I must do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

entries.title: Acts 26:10
segments: "This I also did in Jerusalem, and many of the saints I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I cast my vote against [them].

entries.title: Acts 26:11
segments: "And I punished them often in every synagogue and compelled [them] to blaspheme; and being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted [them] even to foreign cities.

entries.title: Acts 26:12
segments: ¶"While thus occupied, as I journeyed to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

entries.title: Acts 26:13
segments: "at midday, O king, along the road I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who journeyed with me.

entries.title: Acts 26:14
segments: "And when we all had fallen to the ground, I heard a voice speaking to me and saying in the Hebrew language, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? [It is] hard for you to kick against the goads.'

entries.title: Acts 26:15
segments: "So I said, 'Who are You, Lord?' And He said, 'I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

entries.title: Acts 26:16
segments: 'But rise and stand on your feet; for I have appeared to you for this purpose, to make you a minister and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will yet reveal to you.

entries.title: Acts 26:17
segments: 'I will deliver you from the [Jewish] people, as well as [from] the Gentiles, to whom I now send you,

entries.title: Acts 26:18
segments: 'to open their eyes, [in order] to turn [them] from darkness to light, and [from] the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in Me.'

entries.title: Acts 26:19
segments: "Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

entries.title: Acts 26:20
segments: "but declared first to those in Damascus and in Jerusalem, and throughout all the region of Judea, and [then] to the Gentiles, that they should repent, turn to God, and do works befitting repentance.

entries.title: Acts 26:21
segments: "For these reasons the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill [me].

entries.title: Acts 26:22
segments: "Therefore, having obtained help from God, to this day I stand, witnessing both to small and great, saying no other things than those which the prophets and Moses said would come--

entries.title: Acts 26:23
segments: "that the Christ would suffer, that He would be the first to rise from the dead, and would proclaim light to the [Jewish] people and to the Gentiles."

entries.title: Acts 26:24
segments: ¶Now as he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, "Paul, you are beside yourself! Much learning is driving you mad!"

entries.title: Acts 26:25
segments: But he said, "I am not mad, most noble Festus, but speak the words of truth and reason.

entries.title: Acts 26:26
segments: "For the king, before whom I also speak freely, knows these things; for I am convinced that none of these things escapes his attention, since this thing was not done in a corner.

entries.title: Acts 26:27
segments: "King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you do believe."

entries.title: Acts 26:28
segments: Then Agrippa said to Paul, "You almost persuade me to become a Christian."

entries.title: Acts 26:29
segments: And Paul said, "I would to God that not only you, but also all who hear me today, might become both almost and altogether such as I am, except for these chains."

entries.title: Acts 26:30
segments: When he had said these things, the king stood up, as well as the governor and Bernice and those who sat with them;

entries.title: Acts 26:31
segments: and when they had gone aside, they talked among themselves, saying, "This man is doing nothing deserving of death or chains."

entries.title: Acts 26:32
segments: Then Agrippa said to Festus, "This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar."
